finding.surface: root Inspector -> responsive flex/grid item styles -> public authored page root
finding.problem: The authored root is a child of the normal-flow .content-page wrapper, but the Inspector exposed flex item (flexGrow, flexShrink, flexBasis, alignSelf) and grid item (gridColumn, gridRow) controls on that root.
finding.effect: Those six root values are syntactically stored and can be emitted as CSS, but cannot affect root placement in its block parent. Child nodes remain eligible because their root parent can be switched to Flex or Grid.

change.behavior: Exclude only ROOT from flex.grow, flex.shrink, flex.basis, flex.alignSelf, grid.column, and grid.row. Ordinary nodes retain these controls; parent layout mode determines which child group the live Inspector shows.
change.root_filter_helper: nonRootNodeTypes is shared by the existing root overflow restriction and these item-only properties.
